description: This file defines API endpoints for task management in a FastAPI application. It includes functions for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and marking tasks as complete, utilizing dependency injection for user authentication and interacting with a database service.

methods.name: create_task( task_data: TaskCreate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Creates a new task assigned to the authenticated user, handling validation and database interaction.

methods.name: get_tasks( status: Optional[TaskStatus] = Query(None, description="Filter by task status"), priority: Optional[TaskPriority] = Query(None, description="Filter by task priority"), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, max_length=100, description="Search in title and description"), due_date_from: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Filter tasks due from this date"), due_date_to: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Filter tasks due until this date"), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), per_page: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Items per page (max 100)"), current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tasks with optional filtering by status, priority, due date, and search query.

methods.name: get_task( task_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific task by ID for the authenticated user.

methods.name: update_task( task_id: str, task_data: TaskUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing task identified by ID, ensuring the task belongs to the current user.

methods.name: delete_task( task_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Deletes a task specified by ID, only if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: mark_task_complete( task_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Marks a specified task as completed, updating its status and timestamp.
